title: Block 3: Upgrade the Strategist engine to perform hyper-fractal fan-o
description: Upgrade the Strategist engine to perform hyper-fractal fan-out, decomposing work into hyper-specific, non-generalist micro-tasks tied to the flat adjacency array. [Acceptance Criteria: Strategist logic forbids generalist prompts (e.g., "design the button") in favor of atomic commands, writing them strictly as flat parent/child relationships.]
